funFacts: Arsenal's first three-win start conceding fewer than two since the Invincibles season, per PremierLeague.com.
Chelsea had scored inside five minutes in each of their first three games.
headline: Arsenal 2-1 Chelsea: champions pass the first real test
whyCareReason: Both sides had two wins from two. Only Arsenal still have nine points. Odegaard's winner is an early title marker.
teaser: Morgan Rogers scored after 77 seconds. Kai Havertz equalised. Martin Odegaard won it. David Raya saved Estevao late.
story:
Why this one matters: after three games only Arsenal and Manchester City have nine points. This was the first time both London sides sat on a perfect record and one of them had to blink.

Morgan Rogers volleyed Chelsea ahead after 77 seconds, the third straight Chelsea game with a goal inside five minutes, a Premier League first. Kai Havertz equalised in the 25th minute against his former club. Martin Odegaard finished a flowing move shortly after the break. Estevao was denied a late equaliser by David Raya.

Mikel Arteta told Sky it was a joy to watch from start to finish. Xabi Alonso called Chelsea's afternoon suffering. Attendance 60,240 at the Emirates. Referee Chris Kavanagh.
stakes: Early title geometry. Nine points versus six.
rivalryAngle: London, two perfect records, one left standing.
